the six beats of the demo
Open the Overview on the panel
Eight zones, colour only where something runs or faults. Tap a zone to reach its cell page.
Zone 5 turns red on the mimic, the alarm strip names it, and the Alarms page carries it with a note.
Nothing moves - the permissive list says which interlock, and the footer says what to do about it.
Inject GUARD OPEN, then clear it
The guard permissive drops, motion is inhibited, the banner and footer both explain why.
Same screen, same tags. Jog, gripper and service routines go read-only and say so.
Ack and shelve on the stock component, journal history underneath, this machine's alarms only.
Robot drops a case, vacuum decays
